workflow_runs.name: CI/CD
workflow_runs.display_title: perf: major performance improvements - router guard, DB pool, server …

head_commit.message:
perf: major performance improvements - router guard, DB pool, server startup, MutationObserver

- Router: parse session once, remove hidden API call on every navigation, remove triple JSON.parse
- DB pool: reduce max from 20 to 5, add min 1, reduce idle timeout for Render free tier
- Server startup: run migrations async (non-blocking), server accepts requests immediately
- MutationObserver: debounce 300ms to reduce DOM re-scan frequency
- Request logging: only log errors and slow requests (>2s)
